description: This file contains an abstract base class 'AbstractMetaDataImplementation' that provides common functionality for parsing, loading, and saving module metadata view definitions in the SuiteCRM platform. It defines methods for managing view definitions, loading from and saving to files, and merging field definitions, serving as a bridge pattern for different layout implementations.

classes.name: AbstractMetaDataImplementation
classes.description: An abstract class providing common methods for handling module view metadatas such as loading, saving, and merging layout definitions for SuiteCRM modules.

methods.name: getViewdefs
methods.description: Returns the current view definitions loaded from a file.

methods.name: getOriginalViewdefs
methods.description: Returns the original view definitions as loaded.

methods.name: getOriginalViewTemplateDefinitions
methods.description: Returns the original view template definitions.

methods.name: getFielddefs
methods.description: Returns the field definitions associated with the layout.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Provides access to the history object for the layout.

methods.name: _loadFromFile
methods.description: Loads a view layout definition from a specified PHP file, returning the definitions as an array.

methods.name: _loadFromPopupFile
methods.description: Loads a popup view layout definition from a specified file, with additional processing for popup specifics.

methods.name: _saveToFile
methods.description: Writes the layout definitions back to a PHP file, optionally including module variables.

methods.name: hasToAppendOriginalViewTemplateDefs
methods.description: Determines whether to append the original view template definitions when saving.

methods.name: _mergeFielddefs
methods.description: Merges field definitions from a layout into existing field definitions, handling nested structures.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Constructs filename for a layout in a module, for the default location.

methods.name: getFileNameInPackage
methods.description: Constructs a full path filename for module metadata in a specified package and location.

methods.name: getModuleDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path of the module, based on internal module reference.
